findings.title: Direct LLM API calls bypass model router in emergency alerts

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys instead of routing through model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to route LLM queries through the centralized model router interface

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing policies, observability, rate limiting, and centralized fallback handling

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router specifies call log path at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates and maintains call_log.jsonl with appropriate directory write permissions

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into router request volumes, token usage, latency metrics, and error rates

findings.title: Model router reports repeated recent failures

evidence.observation: Model router reports 5 recent failed invocations while recent_avg_ms is null

proposed_action.description: Investigate router failure logs and test backend inference connectivity to Ollama and cloud provider targets

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents upstream application task failures across dependent services requiring LLM completions

findings.title: Incomplete Phase 5 implementations and stubbed anomaly queries

evidence.observation: TODO stub leaving recent_anomalies empty without querying quality_anomalies table
Multiple TODO comments for Phase 5 Supabase authorization and decision_to_memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement database querying for quality anomalies and complete authorization checking in research commands

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures forecasting algorithms use real historical data and prevents unauthorized execution of research commands
